applicant_utility.summary: ESOP is ETH's full-cost Master award: CHF 13,500 per semester for living and study expenses from HS27 plus a tuition fee waiver for the whole three- or four-semester programme, with mentorship and the ETH Foundation network attached. The catch is the calendar: you can only apply inside the first Master application window (1-30 November 2026 for an HS27 start), so a strong applicant who waits for the regular window is eliminated regardless of merit. Only around 60 scholarships are assigned for 2027/28, roughly top-10%-of-bachelor standard, decided by programme admissions committees with the Rector making the final call and results at the end of March.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Top-decile bachelor's graduates (including ETH bachelor students going straight into a consecutive Master) who want every franc of study and living cost covered in Zurich and can file a credible thesis pre-proposal in November.
application_readiness_checklist: Plan the whole application around 1-30 November 2026 - the ESOP option is only open in this first window
Self-assess honestly: ETH expects a top 10% (grade A) bachelor result
Draft the Master's thesis pre-proposal early with genuine scientific citation practice - plagiarism or sloppy referencing voids both admission and scholarship
Keep the phone number on your CV reachable in February for a possible phone/VC interview, or tell the study programme coordinator if unavailable
Confirm whether your programme requires references; if not, line up two professors to upload letters when the system emails them
common_rejection_risks: Applying in the second Master window - you keep admission eligibility but lose ESOP
A copied or lightly edited pre-proposal, which ETH treats as grounds for exclusion or later revocation
Being already enrolled in, or holding, a Master's degree (including a consecutive ETH Master already underway)
Banking on the interview: selections can include a February phone/VC interview, so unreachable applicants disadvantage themselves
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The published award covers study and living costs via the per-semester allowance plus a tuition waiver; no travel or relocation allowance is published, so flights and one-off settling costs are personal.
document_audit: The pre-proposal is in addition to, not instead of, the standard Master admission documents
Reference letters are uploaded by the professors themselves after a system email - a letter you attach yourself does not count
alerts: The number of scholarships (about 60 for 2027/28) depends on the availability of funds and is not guaranteed
ETH publishes the closing time as 11.59h MEZ in the headline but 12.59 MEZ in the body - aim to submit well before midday on 30 November
Only ETH Bachelor students may start ESOP with a leave of absence
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Single eApply Master application in the first November window with the pre-proposal uploaded; admissions committees evaluate and the Rector decides, with outcomes by end of March.

applicant_utility.summary: Treat this fellowship as a CHF 40,000-maximum stipend across your Master's (CHF 10,000 per semester, up to four semesters) plus a reserved student room - not as free tuition: EPFL's own page says fellows are 'responsible for managing all living expenses, including tuition fees and rent'. The window is unforgiving: external applications must be paid and validated by 15 December, and anything later is fine for admission but dead for the fellowship. Selection rewards remarkable grades plus something distinctive outside the classroom - research output, a start-up, patents, sport or civic leadership - and the second year only continues if you average 5.0/6 with 50 ECTS.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving incoming Master's students (EPFL's own bachelor graduates and external candidates alike) with a standout extracurricular or research profile who can fund tuition and rent themselves.
application_readiness_checklist: Submit and PAY the application early enough to be validated by 15 December - validation, not submission, is the deadline
Check the excellence-fellowship box on the form; internal same-field candidates apply directly to their section instead
If internal, brief two referees to email recommendation letters straight to the fellowship address by 31 January
Declare any other substantial scholarship you hold - undeclared combination is a compliance risk
Open a Swiss bank or postal account on arrival, since payments can only be made into one
common_rejection_risks: Application validated after 15 December - still admitted, but fellowship-ineligible
Reference letters that arrive late (internal track) or are uploaded by the candidate instead of the referee
Already holding a Master's degree or being enrolled in an EPFL Master - outright ineligibility
Second-year lapse: below 50 ECTS (language, admission and out-of-plan credits excluded) or below a 5.0/6 ECTS-weighted average ends renewal with no exceptions
Combining the fellowship with another substantial scholarship without declaring it
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition fees, rent and all living costs sit with the student by EPFL's own statement; the reserved student room helps with housing but rent is still payable, and the certificate of excellence is the only non-cash extra.
document_audit: External candidates file no extra fellowship documents - the admission file is the fellowship file, so errors there cost both
Internal applicants must supply a full EPFL transcript and two referee-submitted letters that the admissions documents do not require
alerts: EPFL labels 15 December the 'new deadline' for the 2027 fellowship - do not rely on older listings
If a selected candidate withdraws, the offer passes to the waiting list with a new confirmation deadline, so respond fast
Only one master's programme may be applied for per year
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: One Master application (IS-Academia or direct to section for internal same-field candidates) with the fellowship box ticked inside the first window; sections screen, the Excellence Fellowships Committee decides, notification late March.
